stem: Milk looks uniform to the eye, yet the path of a laser beam is clearly visible when it passes through dilute milk. What is the best conclusion?
options: Milk is a true solution, since it looks so uniform
Milk is a suspension, since its particles settle
Milk is a pure substance having only one component
Milk is heterogeneous; its particles scatter light
explanation: Correct option: (D). Scattering of light shows that milk contains particles large enough to scatter light, so it is not a true solution even though it appears uniform; it is a colloid and is classed as heterogeneous. Milk particles do not settle, so it is not a suspension, and milk has several components, so it is not a pure substance.

stem: A student wants 500 mL of 5% v/v vinegar from glacial (100%) acetic acid. Which procedure is correct?
